summary.intent: Generate PLAN.md files for Phase 68 (Web Integration — Rotation UX and Durable Client State) of the GSD cipher-box roadmap via research → plan → verify workflow, then correct the plan set after the user flagged a testing-strategy violation.
summary.outcome: Produced and verified a 10-plan set across 4 waves (up from an initial 9-plan/3-wave set) that hoists rotation/reconcile logic into the SDK (Vitest-tested), keeps apps/web as thin untested adapters, and adds a new web-e2e Playwright wave (68-10); all coverage gates (ROT-07, 13 CONTEXT decisions, post-planning gap analysis) passed and VALIDATION.md/state/roadmap were finalized and committed.

repo: cipher-box docs/TESTING.md doctrine: apps/web has NO unit tests — core logic must live in packages/sdk (Vitest-tested via injected seams like HighWaterStore/transport) and UI/durability behavior is only verified through Playwright specs under tests/web-e2e/, never apps/web/src/*.test.ts

apps/web actually has a vitest config and ~10 existing *.test.ts files, but none are in the CI unit-test gate or coverage-threshold table — existence of a test file there doesn't mean it's doctrine-sanctioned
apps/api uses Jest with *.spec.ts (correct for that package); the '.spec.ts ban' in gsd plans applies only to apps/web, not apps/api

packages/sdk/src/client.ts is the correct chokepoint for wiring rotation into mutation methods (renameItem, moveItem, deleteItem, deleteToBin) — the web React hooks are thin wrappers and should not contain rotation logic
executeLazyRotation had zero live callers in the repo (dead code / free to delete); addShareKeys/reWrapForRecipients had real callers in useAuth.ts and useSharedNavigation.ts needing rerouting

share.service.ts's fetchReceivedShares/fetchSentShares were stub throws with no real data path, even though the generated API client already exposed the needed fields — a scope gap invisible from CONTEXT.md alone
No backing API endpoint existed for grant re-mint persistence (reMintGrantsRootedAt's updateGrantFn) — required a new apps/api PATCH route + pnpm api:generate, expanding blast radius beyond apps/web
No idb npm package used anywhere in repo — durable IndexedDB stores follow a hand-rolled raw indexedDB Promise-wrapping pattern (see identity.ts, search-index.service.ts)
navigator.locks has no prior usage in the codebase — first-time use pattern for D-09 multi-tab leader election

GSD plan-checker commit_failed messages during this session were repeatedly false negatives — lint-staged succeeded and commits landed each time; always verify actual git status/log before trusting the reported failure

code.finding: Existing anti-clobber sequenceNumber guard here can be reused with inverted polarity for D-04's rotation defer-never-skip logic

workflow: When a subagent research/verify pass surfaces scope gaps not in the original CONTEXT.md (e.g., missing API endpoints, stub data paths), plan them as explicit tasks rather than silently expanding scope or ignoring them

Plan-checker warnings should be triaged individually: cheap correctness fixes (missing depends_on edge) applied immediately, doc-hygiene items (RESEARCH.md open-questions marking) applied immediately, but frontmatter/status reconciliation tied to future execution steps left deferred as advised

When a domain doctrine document (like TESTING.md) contradicts an in-progress plan, verify actual on-the-ground repo state before rewriting (don't trust either the doc's stated landscape or your own prior assumption blindly) — the reality was more nuanced (apps/web has some test files but they're outside the enforced gates)
After being corrected on a non-obvious cross-cutting rule, save it to persistent memory immediately before applying the fix, so future sessions don't repeat the mistake

Re-verification after a significant replan should specifically target the changed dimension (test-strategy doctrine) in the checker prompt rather than a generic full re-check, to get focused confidence on what changed

friction: Initial plan set (9 plans) violated the project's core testing doctrine (apps/web must not have unit tests, logic must live in SDK) — this wasn't caught by the planner, pattern-mapper, or plan-checker in the first pass, only by the user referencing docs/TESTING.md directly, causing a full replan of all 9 plans plus a new e2e plan
Multiple 'commit_failed' false-negative messages during the session required manual git status verification each time to confirm commits actually landed
Decision-coverage gate produced no output on first run and had to be re-run to see the actual result
Post-planning gap-analysis gate initially appeared to parse-fail due to a stderr warning getting mixed into the output file, requiring a rerun to get clean JSON
Commit helper failed to stage 68-VALIDATION.md on the first attempt at session end, requiring a retry with an explicit path
open_items: VALIDATION.md's nyquist_compliant flag and sign-off checklist were flagged by the plan-checker as not yet reconciled after the original Wave-0 gap closure; this was later fixed but reflects a pattern where VALIDATION.md status fields lag behind the plan set
